Command: Do not reap the corner of your field
Summary: The corner of the field is not to be reaped wholly; a corner is left standing for the poor.
Commandment: Do not reap the corner of your field.
Application: Leaving the corner unreaped is deliberate incompleteness: the owner stops short of his full harvest so that the landless have a field to glean. The corner is not an accident of farming but a provision of law.
Purpose: God's stated care for those without a defender — widow, orphan, stranger — carried by James into the church as pure religion (James 1:27). In the field, that care takes the form of an unreaped corner.
